assertions.summary: Live inspection found only the expected Prometheus/node_exporter state and configuration, with no failed units, duplicate processes, conflicting scrape definitions, stale evaluator artifacts, or extra users; node_exporter access was restricted by active UFW rules.

evidence.command:
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true
ps -eo pid=,user=,comm=,args= | grep -E '[p]rometheus|[n]ode[-_]exporter' || true
systemctl show prometheus.service -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ExecStart -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState -p UnitFileState 2>&1 || true
sudo -n ss -ltnp 2>&1 || true
evidence.observation: No failed units. Exactly one Prometheus process was present, active/running and enabled, with 127.0.0.1:9090 as its listener. No node_exporter process ran on node1. No unintended monitoring listener was present.
